Manager of Party Instance Zones Benusta:
Yokai have invaded Sakura Isle, the training ground of the Samurais. To stop them, you need to defeat their leader, Yokai General.
As long as his minions protect him, Yokai General can not be harmed. So, before you challenge the General himself, you need to kill 100 of his minions.
After entering the instance zone, you need to choose the difficulty level. After you've made your choice, the entry will be limited until 6:30 regardless of the results.
Party members may re-enter the instance zone during the battle, but if all of them leave the zone, they need to return within 1 minute.
